quirk: Q-01 POLRNW expiry = YYYYMMDD + 10000 renews 20240229 to 20250229
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off; AB-526): the renewal uses LocalDate.plusYears(1), so the renewed POLICY-RECORD message carries expiry 20250228 instead of the invalid 20250229.

quirk: Q-09 POLRNW failed UPDATE still confirms
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off; AB-526): the Java renewal is one transaction, so a failed update commits nothing and no PolicyRenewed/DocumentRequested event (hence no message) is published.

quirk: Q-14 POLEND continues after a failed ENDORSEMENTS INSERT
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off; AB-526): the Java endorsement is atomic, so a failed insert commits nothing and no ENDORSEMENT-AUDIT equivalent (PolicyEndorsed/DocumentRequested) is published.

quirk: Q-01 invalid expiry 20250229 produced by the POLRNW leap-year defect
rationale: A PostgreSQL DATE cannot hold 20250229 and the Q-01 fix stops the Java renewal producing it, so no Java policy version has this expiry and no message is built.
